title: E-FRC-0199: nuclei on the confined point of the D4 field, read through Polyakov lines: two static color singlets...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0199 in the gauge arena: nuclei on the confined point of the D4 field, read through Polyakov lines: two static color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons) on the coupled Sigma(648) rule at fill 0.08 show no residual at any of 14 separations (under 5e-4 of their weight), the quark-antiquark pair is a 7-error signal only at the closest separation, the static baryon and the saturation readings are at noise, a substrate reading.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
